meta.title: KOOK bot (local rc.5 build)
meta.description: Connect KOOK private messages and allowed channels to DSH 0.2.2-rc.5 over WebSocket for direct @bot wakeup, text, image input and workspace image replies. Configure it in Account menu → Settings → KOOK; use this page for activation and version management. Saving settings stops active KOOK tasks and reconnects. Image understanding requires a compatible model; approvals remain in local DSH.
